new_evidence: controlled reproductive study reports partial self-compatibility and autogamy
recommended_action: reconcile the existing SI token against direct self-compatibility/autogamy evidence before any genus-rule use
review_note: Wave52 composition simultaneously contains autonomous selfing, obligate selfing and SI. The direct crossing literature makes the SI component suspect and the cell requires repair rather than propagation.

new_evidence: hand self- and cross-pollination gave similar seed set in a partially autogamous population
recommended_action: retain population/source heterogeneity; block Portulaca-wide obligate-selfing or SI promotion
review_note: Older controlled study supports selfing whereas other studies/accessions report strong SI. Treat this as biological/taxonomic heterogeneity, not a universal genus state.

new_evidence: controlled greenhouse self-fertilizations produced no fruit and were interpreted as SI
recommended_action: retain population/source heterogeneity; investigate accession identity before adjudicating species-wide state
review_note: The recent Brazilian accession study conflicts with the 1993 partially autogamous study. Do not use either result to create a Portulaca-wide state.
